table.retrieve:
SELECT  
	InvoiceCode=P.PurInvCode,
	Date=Date,
	Supplier=A.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	Address = RTRIM(LTRIM(S.Address1)) + ' ' + RTRIM(LTRIM(S.Address2)),
	City = S.City,
	Country = S.Country,
	NetAmt=InvTotal,
	PaidOnInv=Amt,
	OtherPayments=ISNULL((SELECT debit=SUM(debit) FROM GLdetail D, GLHeader H 
			WHERE  H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
					 D.InvoiceCode = P.PurInvCode AND 
					 H.VochCatCode IN 
					(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
					WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=2)),0),
	Credits=ISNULL((SELECT credit=SUM(credit) FROM GLdetail D, GLHeader H 
			WHERE  H.GLVochCode = D.GLVochCode AND 
					 D.InvoiceCode = P.PurInvCode AND 
					 H.VochCatCode IN 
					(SELECT V.VochCatCode FROM VocherCategory V
					WHERE V.InvoiceBased=1 AND V.InvoiceType=2)),0),
	ChequesPaid=ISNULL((SELECT Amt=SUM(D.Amt) FROM Notesdetail D, Notes H 
			WHERE  D.InvoiceCode = P.PurInvCode AND H.NoteCatCode=2 AND H.NoteCode = D.NoteCode), 0),
	AllocatedReturns=ISNULL((SELECT Amt=SUM(D.Amt) FROM PRAllocationdetail D, PRAllocationHeader H 
			WHERE  D.PurInvCode = P.PurInvCode AND H.PRAllocationCode = D.PRAllocationCode), 0),
	Balance=OutstandingAmt,
	Posted=P.Posted,
	SuppInvNo = P.SuppInvCode,
	SuppInvDate = P.SuppInvDate,
	HeaderInvCode=P.HeaderInvNo,
	HeaderNo=P.HeaderNo

FROM PurLedger P, Accounts A, Supplier S
WHERE
	P.AccountFor = 'Y' AND
	P.Marked = 'N' AND
	P.Date >= :ad_startdate AND P.DATE <= :ad_enddate AND
	P.SuppCode = A.AccCode AND
	A.AccCode = S.SuppCode
ORDER BY
	Supplier,
	PurInvCode,
	Date
table.sort: supplier A, invoicecode A, date A
